show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/Kzab7a
show.description: In his past life, betrayed by his wife and best friend, an air traffic controller heroically saved a plane from disaster caused by their deliberate sabotage. Despite his selfless act, he was framed, publicly condemned, and ultimately beaten to death by enraged passengers fueled by their lies. Reborn, he chooses a different path. This time, he will watch as they face the devastating consequences of their own actions.
